item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We know that smoking a pack a day for 30 years raises a person’s lung cancer risk many times over. We stand for clear warnings, prevention and support for everyone ready to quit.

2. We won’t soften the message: smoking a pack a day for 30 years multiplies the risk of lung cancer. We want everyone to understand that danger—and have access to help quitting.

3. We believe clear information saves lives. Smoking a pack a day for 30 years raises lung cancer risk many times over. We call for stronger prevention and accessible quitting support, without shame or blame.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We stand for a clear, urgent message: smoking a pack a day for 30 years raises a person’s risk of lung cancer many times over. We will not soften that fact, and we will not shame the people who need support. We want everyone to understand the danger of long-term smoking and have a real opportunity to quit. That means accessible cessation services, honest public education and a commitment to prevention. We know that quitting smoking reduces lung cancer risk over time. In this newsletter, we renew our commitment to helping people take that step and to building communities where support is available when it is needed.
